_comment: Garment-flat measurements in centimetres, from the AW2026 spec sheet. site/src/lib/products.ts and the Kalles theme's sizing page BOTH read this file; neither restates it. A null is a measurement the factory has not confirmed and it must render as an em dash, never as a number: four rows in the spec sheet run backwards at L (chest 48->42, body length 68->66, inseam 77->73), which would make L smaller than M and drive returns. Publishing a guess there costs more than leaving the cell blank.
